sources.text: Notaries must adhere to the following requirements when providing notary services:Cayman Bank Customers: Notarize both Cayman Bank documents and non-Cayman Bank documents. Note: A Cayman Bank customer is an individual who has transaction authority on any Cayman Bank account relationship. Non-customers: Notarize only Cayman Bank documents unless the notary’s state laws provide an exception. Exceptions: Notaries in Arizona, Iowa, New York, South Dakota, and Utah must notarize both Cayman Bank documents and non-Cayman Bank documents regardless of their customer status. If a customer requests a notarization on a non-Cayman Bank document that also lists other present individuals (non-customers) requiring a notarization on the same document, notaries may notarize all individuals’ signatures regardless of their customer status. Notarize documents only at a Cayman Bank branch during business hours. Do not go offsite to complete notarizations during business work hours to conduct bank business transactions. Notarize only physical documents presented in person by the requester. Do not notarize documents sent by email, fax, mail, or text, even if the requester is present.
